mapper.select: SELECT ROOM_NO, MEMBER_NO_1, MEMBER_NO_2, CREATED_AT FROM TB_CHAT_ROOM WHERE (MEMBER_NO_1 = #{no1} AND MEMBER_NO_2 = #{no2}) OR (MEMBER_NO_1 = #{no2} AND MEMBER_NO_2 = #{no1})
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CHAT_ROOM.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_CHAT_ROOM (ROOM_NO, MEMBER_NO_1, MEMBER_NO_2, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{roomNo}, #{memberNo1}, #{memberNo2}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT r.ROOM_NO, r.MEMBER_NO_1, r.MEMBER_NO_2, r.CREATED_AT, CASE WHEN r.MEMBER_NO_1 = #{memberNo} THEN r.MEMBER_NO_2 ELSE r.MEMBER_NO_1 END AS TARGET_MEMBER_NO, CASE WHEN r.MEMBER_NO_1 = #{memberNo} THEN m2.NAME ELSE m1.NAME END AS TARGET_NAME, CASE WHEN r.MEMBER_NO_1 = #{memberNo} THEN m2.ROLE ELSE m1.ROLE END AS TARGET_ROLE, lm.CONTENT AS LAST_MESSAGE, lm.SENT_AT AS LAST_MESSAGE_AT, NVL(un.CNT, 0) AS UNREAD_COUNT FROM TB_CHAT_ROOM r JOIN TB_MEMBER m1 ON m1.MEMBER_NO = r.MEMBER_NO_1 JOIN TB_MEMBER m2 ON m2.MEMBER_NO = r.MEMBER_NO_2 /* 마지막 메시지 */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROOM_NO, CONTENT, SENT_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ROOM_NO ORDER BY SENT_AT DESC) AS RN FROM TB_CHAT_MSG ) lm ON lm.ROOM_NO = r.ROOM_NO AND lm.RN = 1 /* 안읽음 수 */ LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ROOM_NO, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM TB_CHAT_MSG WHERE SENDER_NO != #{memberNo} AND READ_YN = 'N' GROUP BY ROOM_NO ) un ON un.ROOM_NO = r.ROOM_NO WHERE r.MEMBER_NO_1 = #{memberNo} OR r.MEMBER_NO_2 = #{memberNo} ORDER BY NVL(lm.SENT_AT, r.CREATED_AT) DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CHAT_MSG.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO TB_CHAT_MSG (MSG_NO, ROOM_NO, SENDER_NO, MSG_TYPE, CONTENT, FILE_URL, READ_YN, SENT_AT) VALUES (#{msgNo}, #{roomNo}, #{senderNo}, #{msgType}, #{content}, #{fileUrl}, 'N', SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT m.MSG_NO, m.ROOM_NO, m.SENDER_NO, mb.NAME AS SENDER_NAME, m.MSG_TYPE, m.CONTENT, m.FILE_URL, m.READ_YN, m.SENT_AT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY m.SENT_AT ASC) AS RN FROM TB_CHAT_MSG m JOIN TB_MEMBER mb ON mb.MEMBER_NO = m.SENDER_NO WHERE m.ROOM_NO = #{roomNo} ) WHERE RN BETWEEN #{offset} + 1 AND #{offset} + #{limit}
